name: Supplier Payment Report
sql_query:
SELECT payment_date, payment_no, payment_type, supplier_code, supplier_name, reference,
       cash, cheque, bank_transfer, cash + cheque + bank_transfer AS total, note
FROM (
    -- Paid when the goods were received (GRN)
    SELECT h.Invoice_date AS payment_date, h.Invoice_no AS payment_no, 'Payment at Purchase' AS payment_type,
           h.supplier_code, COALESCE(s.name, h.Customer_Name) AS supplier_name,
           CONCAT_WS(' / ', h.Invoice_no, NULLIF(h.Ref_no, '')) AS reference,
           h.cash_payment AS cash, h.cheque_payment AS cheque, 0 AS bank_transfer, NULL AS note
    FROM t_purchases_sums h
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.Code = h.supplier_code
    WHERE h.BC = :bc AND h.Invoice_date BETWEEN :from AND :to
      AND h.cash_payment + h.cheque_payment > 0

    -- Supplier payments (against GRNs)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.Payment_date, p.Payment_no, 'Supplier Payment',
           p.Supplier_Code, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.Supplier_Name, ''), s.name),
           (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(a.purchase_invoice_no ORDER BY a.purchase_invoice_no SEPARATOR ', ')
              FROM t_supplier_invoice_payments a WHERE a.payment_no = p.Payment_no),
           p.cash_payment, p.cheque_payment, p.bank_transfer + p.card_payment, p.Payment_note
    FROM t_supplier_payments p
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.Code = p.Supplier_Code
    WHERE p.BC = :bc AND p.Payment_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    -- Service (repair) supplier payments
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sp.payment_date, sp.payment_no, 'Service Supplier Payment',
           d.supplier_code, s.name,
           CONCAT('Dispatch ', sp.dispatch_no, ' / Ticket ', d.ticket_no),
           IF(sp.payment_method = 'cash', sp.amount, 0),
           IF(sp.payment_method = 'cheque', sp.amount, 0),
           IF(sp.payment_method = 'bank_transfer', sp.amount, 0),
           sp.payment_note
    FROM t_service_supplier_payments sp
    JOIN t_service_dispatches d ON d.dispatch_no = sp.dispatch_no
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.Code = d.supplier_code
    WHERE sp.BC = :bc AND sp.payment_date BETWEEN :from AND :to
) payments
WHERE (:supplier     IS NULL OR supplier_code = :supplier)
  AND (:payment_type IS NULL OR payment_type = :payment_type)
  AND (:payment_method IS NULL
       OR (:payment_method = 'cash'   AND cash > 0)
       OR (:payment_method = 'cheque' AND cheque > 0)
       OR (:payment_method = 'bank'   AND bank_transfer > 0))
ORDER BY payment_date, payment_no;
